provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The White Castle rulebook (Devir, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Shuffle the Steward and Diplomat decks separately; 1 faceup card in each space of its level
steps.note: 2 players: first remove the cards marked with a diamond. Redo if every card shows the same dark-background action

steps.text: 1 random Daimyo card on the last level; box the rest
Die tiles: one of each color on the 3 diamond spaces, then fill the rooms in numerical order - at least 2 dice colors per room; Well tiles go dice side down
Round marker on the first space; coins, Daimyo Seals and +40/+80 tiles in a reserve
{n} dice of each color; roll each color and line them on its Bridge, lowest on the left by the lantern
1 random Plant Garden and 1 random Stone Garden card below each Bridge
4 random Yard tiles on their spaces, indicated side up
Domain board with 5 Courtiers, 5 Gardeners and 5 Warriors; 3 Resource cubes on 0; Fan token by the Clan Points track
Stack the Influence markers in random order on the Heron; Heron tokens on the Turn Order track in that order (top goes first)
Reveal Starting Resource cards equal to players + 1, a random Starting Action card under each
In reverse turn order each picks a pair: Action card onto the Domain board, gain the resources, Resource card into the Lantern Area
In turn order, take a die from a Bridge and place it on an action
